about: Every string of the page areas that the meaning check flagged (back-translation by MADLAD-400 scored with MiniLM, and LaBSE scoring the translation against the English directly, both under 0.6: the rule of branch lang/qa-pipeline), read by the engineer on branch lang/pages-rest (a language model, Claude; not a native speaker), with what was decided. A record names the exact text it was made for: when the string changes, the record no longer matches and scripts/pages-rest/summarise.mjs --strict reports the string as not read. Also listed: strings changed after reading their back-translation although they were not flagged by both signals.
